name: Industrial Complex — Armenia
summary: Multi-disciplinary industrial installation combining structural, mechanical, and welding works for an international client in Armenia.

challenges.problem: Try to complete the project in damanded time and do it well and monitor everything.
challenges.solution: Established a phased procurement plan and coordinated directly with local Armenian suppliers to eliminate delays.

name: Industrial Steam Boiler Manufacturing
summary: Design and fabrication of high-pressure industrial steam boilers compliant with ASME pressure-vessel codes.

challenges.problem: Achieving X-ray quality welds on thick-walled pressure vessels.
challenges.solution: Implemented multi-pass welding with pre-heat and post-weld heat treatment, verified by radiographic testing.

challenges.problem: Ensuring thermal efficiency and safe steam distribution.
challenges.solution: Designed insulation and steam trapping systems according to ASME Section I requirements.

name: Hospital MEP Installation
summary: Complete mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems for a multi-ward hospital, including medical gas pipelines and critical HVAC.

challenges.solution: Orginized a great plan for each step and try to be planner.

challenges.problem: Maintaining strict air quality in operating rooms during construction.
challenges.solution: Coordinated with hospital staff on a phased schedule and used HEPA-filtered temporary ventilation.

name: 100-Unit Residential Tower
summary: Full building systems installation for a 100+ unit residential tower, including HVAC, plumbing, gas, and fire safety.

challenges.problem: Balancing water pressure across 22 floors with variable demand.
challenges.solution: Designed a zoned pressure-boosting system with separate risers for low, mid, and high-rise sections.

challenges.problem: Coordinating MEP routes with limited ceiling space.
challenges.solution: Used BIM coordination to resolve clashes before installation, saving 3 weeks of rework.

name: Industrial Welding & Gas Piping
summary: Certified welding and gas piping for commercial and industrial facilities under European EN standards.

name: Commercial Complex — Gas & Fire Systems
summary: Complete gas piping and firefighting systems for a multi-tenant commercial complex.
